content: Nuna Kirstoosi geeshshiday nuni geeshshateththan daanaassa; hessa gishshas minni eqqite; nam7anththo aylleteththa qambaran gelopite.
Ta inttes gizayssa wozinan woththite; intte qaxxarettana koykko Kirstoosi inttena aykkoka go7enna gaada ta Phawuloosi inttes yootays.
Qaxxarettana koyzayti wuri wogaa ubbaa polanayssi dosa gidonttayssa ta inttes issaas issaas qonccen yootays.
Intteno Woga naagon xillana waayettizaytoo! Intte Kirstoosappe shaakettideta; iza kiyateththafekka haakkideta.
Nu qasse ufayssan naagettiza xilloteththaa Xoossa Ayana baggara ammanon laamoteththan naagon doos.
Asi Yesus Kirstoosan diikko qaxxarettiin woykko qaxxarettontta aggiin aykkoka go7enna; go7ay dizay siiqon qoncciza ammano xalla.
Kase lo7o woth woxxeeta shin; ha7i inttes dhuphe gididi tumaas intte azazettontta mala inttena diggiday oonee?
Hessa mala baleththoy inttena xeygida Xoossaafe gidenna.
«Guuththa irshoy liixe ubbaa denththees» geetettiza mala.
Inttes hara qofay deenna gaada tani Godaan ammanettays; inttes tikki gizaaz ooththizay oona gidikko izi ba pirda ekkana.

Ta ishatoo! Hanno gakkanaas ta sabbakizayssi asi attanaas qaxxarettana bessees gizaaz gididaakko histtiin hanno gakkanaas aazas tana gooddizoo? Hessa mala gididaakko Kirstoosa masqaley asas dhuphe gidennakoshin.
Inttes tikki gizaaz ooththiza asati coo wogara qaxxareteth aggidi mulera qanxxi yegetto.
Ta ishatoo! Intte geeshshateththas xeygettideta; intte intte geeshshateththaa zaaridi inttes asho amo polanaas go7ettofte; hessafe intte intte garsan siiqon issoy issaa maaddite.
Wogay wuri shiiqettidi issi qaalan qashettees; hessika, «Neni ase ne mala dosa!» gizayssa.
Gido attiin intte issoy issaara saxettizayta gidikko intte intte garsan wurontta mala naagettite.
Ayanan Simereteth
Hessa gishshas ta inttena Ayanan simerettite; qasseka asho amokka polopite gays.
Ashoy Ayanay koyonttaaz amottees; Ayanaykka ashoy koyonttaaz amottees; hayti issoy issaara ba garsan ixettiza gishshas intte intte koyida mala ooththeketa.
Intte Ayanan dizayta gidikko wogas haarettizayta gidekketa.
Asho oosoy qonccen erettees; hessika laymateth, tunateth, layma kaas,
Eeqas goyno, bita, ixeteth, oosh, qanaateteth, hanqo, bana xalla doso, shaaketeth, zuppeteth,

miqqayneteth, maththoteth, alame mazamure yexeththinne heytantta misatizayta. Tani inttes kase yootida mala ha7ikka intte naagettana mala qofsays; hessa mala duus dizayti wurikka Xoossa kawoteth laattettenna.
Ayana ayfey gidikko siiqo, ufays, saroteth, dandaya, kiyateth, lo7eteth, ammaneteth,
ashketeth, barkka bana haaro; haytantta mala diggiza wogay baa.
Yesus Kirstoosas gididayti asho iza iita qofaaranne iza iita amoteththaara issife kaqqida.
Nu Ayanan daana koykko ane Ayanan simerettoos.
Nuni issoy issaa iitas denththeththishenne qanaatettishe coo mela ceeqettizayssa ane aggoos.
